post.originalText:
Trick landed. Monster cracked. 😳

Not a movie. Not studio CGI.

This is 100% AI — made with Seedance 2.5.

No motion capture, no VFX team, no reshoots. Just a prompt and a few takes.

We're at the point where "that has to be fake" is the biggest compliment.

Made on MakeUGC.

PROMPT

{
 "shot_type": "Multi-scene action POV and third-person video, 9:16 vertical, extreme sports content style",
 "duration": "20 seconds",
 "camera": {
 "setup": "Mix of helmet-mounted POV camera and third-person handheld tracking shots from bystanders",
 "pov_details": "GoPro-style helmet mount, slightly low and centered, wide-angle lens with natural fisheye distortion at the frame edges, visible faint reflection of the visor's inner rim at the bottom of frame",
 "third_person_details": "Handheld smartphone footage from bystanders, natural shake and slight lag when tracking fast motion, occasional quick refocus"
 },
 "setting": {
 "location": "Dirt bike trail cutting through a dense wooded forest",
 "details": [
 "Packed reddish-brown dirt trail with visible tire tracks and small loose rocks",
 "Tall pine and deciduous trees lining both sides, dappled sunlight breaking through the canopy in shifting patches",
 "Constructed dirt mounds and jump ramps with visible compacted layers and tire-worn edges",
 "A small wooden folding table set up at the trail's end with a red cooler, a stack of cups, and a couple of energy drink cans visible inside",
 "Patches of dry grass and scattered fallen leaves along the trail edge",
 "Faint dust haze hanging in the air from previous riders"
 ],
 "time_of_day": "Midday, bright direct sunlight filtering through leaves",
 "atmosphere": "High-energy, adrenaline-charged, dusty outdoor action sport atmosphere"
 },
 "character": {
 "description": "Young man, mid-20s, athletic lean-muscular build, visible light stubble beneath the helmet strap when it's removed, short dark hair damp with sweat once helmet comes off",
 "outfit": "Full-face motocross helmet with a matte black shell and subtle generic red and grey graphic accents, tinted visor reflecting the trees, padded moisture-wicking jersey in dark grey with red accent stripes, black riding gloves with reinforced knuckle padding, black and grey riding pants with knee guards, motocross boots with visible scuff marks and dirt buildup"
 },
 "vehicle": {
 "description": "Dirt bike with a matte dark green and black frame, visible dirt and mud splatter across the fenders and engine housing, worn treaded tires caked with dirt, exhaust pipe with light heat discoloration"
 },
 "sequence": [
 {
 "timestamp": "0:00 - 0:06",
 "scene": "POV Trail Ride",
 "action": "Helmet-mounted POV racing along the dirt trail, trees streaking past in a blur on either side, the front wheel kicking up small clouds of reddish dirt and pebbles visible at the bottom of frame, handlebars vibrating slightly with the terrain, dappled sunlight flickering rapidly across the visor as he passes under the tree canopy",
 "camera_note": "First-person POV, constant fine vibration from the engine, occasional harder jolt over bumps",
 "audio_detail": "Loud two-stroke engine whine, rhythmic popping from the exhaust, wind rushing past the helmet microphone"
 },
 {
 "timestamp": "0:07 - 0:13",
 "scene": "Jumps and Tricks",
 "action": "Cuts to a third-person tracking shot as he approaches a dirt mound at speed, the bike launching off the lip with visible suspension compression just before takeoff, the bike briefly airborne with dirt still spraying off the rear tire, he shifts his weight and kicks one leg out in a stylish mid-air trick before quickly repositioning, then lands with a visible suspension absorb and a small puff of dust kicking up on impact, two bystanders standing at the trail edge holding up their phones filming, one pumping a fist as he lands",
 "camera_note": "Third-person handheld tracking shot following the arc of the jump, slight motion blur on the fastest part of the flight",
 "audio_detail": "Engine note rising in pitch mid-air as the throttle is briefly released, distant excited shouting from the bystanders, thud and dirt-crunch sound on landing"
 },
 {
 "timestamp": "0:14 - 0:16",
 "scene": "The Stop",
 "action": "He rolls up to the small wooden table at the trail's edge, engine winding down as he brakes, comes to a full stop, kicks down the side stand with his boot, swings his leg over the seat, and pulls his helmet off in one motion, revealing damp hair and a slightly flushed, adrenaline-lit expression",
 "camera_note": "Static third-person medium shot, slight natural handheld sway",
 "audio_detail": "Engine idling down to a low rumble then silence, faint mechanical click as the kickstand locks"
 },
 {
 "timestamp": "0:17 - 0:20",
 "scene": "The Reward",
 "action": "A man standing behind the table reaches into the red cooler, pulling out a 500ml beverage can, visible frost and heavy condensation immediately beading and dripping down its matte black surface, hands it directly to the rider who takes it with a satisfied nod, cracks it open with an audible hiss and a small puff of cold vapor escaping the top, takes a satisfied breath before a first sip",
 "product": "Matte black 500ml beverage can with a simple minimal generic logo mark, no real brand name, heavy visible condensation and a few water droplets running down the sides",
 "camera_note": "Static medium shot, close enough to see the condensation detail on the can",
 "audio_detail": "Sharp metallic crack-hiss of the can opening, faint carbonation fizz"
 }
 ],
 "audio": "Loud dirt bike engine throughout riding segments, dirt and gravel crunch, ambient forest sounds (birds, rustling leaves), distant bystander chatter and excitement, can crack and fizz at the end, no music baked in",
 "lighting": {
 "source": "Bright direct midday sunlight filtering through the forest canopy",
 "effect": "Strong dappled light and shadow patterns shifting rapidly across the trail and rider during motion, warm golden tone on the dirt, sharp specular highlight on the wet condensation of the can in the final shot"
 },
 "style": "Ultra-realistic, photorealistic, high-energy gritty action sports content aesthetic, natural dust and dirt texture, authentic action-cam and handheld smartphone visual quality, no digital smoothing",
 "aspect_ratio": "9:16",
 "quality": "high detail, realistic dirt, motion blur, metal, and condensation texture, natural color grading, no airbrushing artifacts, no exaggerated physics"
}
